summary: Build secure cloud and DevSecOps capability for regulated environments with practical architecture, controls, pipeline, and incident exercises. Enquire today.
lede: Secure cloud and DevSecOps training helps cloud architects, DevOps engineers, and compliance officers control cloud delivery and produce evidence. Participants assess cloud risks, map identity and workload controls, review infrastructure-as-code, set CI/CD security gates, and plan incident response and recovery across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
audienceIntro: Secure cloud training suits professionals who influence cloud architecture, software delivery, cyber risk, service continuity, or regulatory evidence. It is designed for experienced practitioners who need a common operating language across technology, security, and compliance teams.
modules: Secure Cloud Architecture with CSA CCM
prerequisites: Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, software delivery, or information security is expected. Experience with identity management, networking, incident handling, or compliance evidence will help, but you do not need to write application code or administer a specific cloud platform. Participants should bring a laptop for document-based exercises. Hands-on activities use provided scenarios and templates rather than production environments.
